job_runs_finished_status_check.name: job_runs_finished_status_check
job_runs_finished_status_check.value:
("status" = 'running'::job_run_status
          AND "finished_at" IS NULL
          AND "lease_owner" IS NOT NULL
          AND "lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("status" <> 'running'::job_run_status
          AND "finished_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "lease_owner" IS NULL
          AND "lease_expires_at" IS NULL)

dev_feedback_items_lease_check.name: dev_feedback_items_lease_check
dev_feedback_items_lease_check.value:
(
        "status" = 'in_progress'::dev_feedback_status
        AND "lease_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "lease_revision" = "current_revision"
        AND "lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "status" <> 'in_progress'::dev_feedback_status
        AND "lease_id" IS NULL
        AND "lease_revision" IS NULL
        AND "lease_expires_at" IS NULL
      )
